name: Focus twins
summary: A study session for two drawn as two tomato timers side by side: both tap in and the same 25 minutes start ticking, each tomato ripens from green to red, stepping away wilts yours until you're back, the break pops both into a shared stretch, and the rounds fill in until it's done.
useWhen: study together? i can't focus alone
pomodoro w me tonight? stats midterm tmrw
keep me accountable for 2 hours of writing
lets lock in, 4 rounds then sleep
facetime study session but make it productive
dontUseWhen: a whole group studying at the library (use fenwick-lights)
a one-off countdown to an event (use countdown)
a habit streak over days (use gym)

people.description: The two studying (names in the chat), left tomato first

quote.description: What started it, in their words; may be empty

notes.description: One short line each, same order as people, shown over their tomato before a round; may be empty strings

focusMin.description: Minutes of focus per round, 5 to 90

breakMin.description: Minutes of break between rounds, 1 to 30

ready.description: Who is already in for the next round (at most one)

doneLine.description: The line shown when all rounds are done, e.g. 'go sleep, midterm's at 9'
